name: Liver Function Test (LFT)
clinicalSignificance: Liver function testing helps evaluate liver health and supports assessment of liver injury and function.
patientPreparation: Fasting may be recommended depending on the clinical requirement.
parameters: Bilirubin Total, Bilirubin Direct, AST, ALT, ALP, Total Protein, Albumin, Globulin

name: Kidney Function Test (KFT)
clinicalSignificance: Kidney function testing helps assess renal function and supports evaluation of kidney-related disorders.
patientPreparation: Follow laboratory instructions. Fasting may be recommended where clinically required.
parameters: Urea, Creatinine, Uric Acid, Sodium, Potassium

name: Urine Routine & Microscopy
clinicalSignificance: Routine urine examination provides information about urinary tract health and may help identify abnormalities.
patientPreparation: Preferably collect a clean-catch midstream urine sample.
parameters: Colour, Appearance, pH, Specific Gravity, Protein, Glucose, Ketones, Blood, Pus Cells, RBCs, Epithelial Cells

name: HbA1c
clinicalSignificance: HbA1c reflects average blood glucose levels over approximately the previous 2-3 months.

name: Lipid Profile
clinicalSignificance: Lipid profile measures blood lipids and supports assessment of cardiovascular risk.
patientPreparation: Fasting may be advised according to clinical requirements.
parameters: Total Cholesterol, Triglycerides, HDL Cholesterol, LDL Cholesterol, VLDL

name: Vitamin B12
clinicalSignificance: Vitamin B12 testing helps assess vitamin B12 status and may be useful in evaluation of deficiency.

name: Vitamin D - 25 Hydroxy
clinicalSignificance: 25-hydroxy vitamin D is the commonly measured blood marker used to assess vitamin D status.

name: CBC Haemogram
clinicalSignificance: CBC evaluates red blood cells, white blood cells, haemoglobin and platelets and supports routine clinical assessment.
parameters: Hb, RBC Count, PCV, MCV, MCH, MCHC, RDW, WBC Count, Differential Count, Platelet Count

name: Thyroid Profile
clinicalSignificance: Thyroid profile testing helps evaluate thyroid function.
patientPreparation: No special preparation generally required unless instructed.

name: Blood Sugar - Fasting
clinicalSignificance: Fasting blood glucose measures blood glucose after a period of fasting and is used in diabetes evaluation.
patientPreparation: Fast for 8-12 hours. Water may generally be taken unless otherwise instructed.
